video_title: Luis Scola: "Vi a GIANNIS y supe que había llegado el FINAL" #29

quotes.speaker: Luis Scola
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA defensive rules create more space for offensive play
quotes.excerpt: the NBA has rules in particular that you cannot touch the paint defensively speaking, so there is more space
quotes.quote: The NBA has rules in particular that you cannot touch the paint defensively speaking, so there is more space and that generates more basketball, more offensive, which makes sense too.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: La NBA tiene unas reglas en particular que no puedes pisar la pintura defensivamente hablando, entonces hay más espacio y eso te genera más baloncesto, más ofensivo, que tiene sentido también.

quotes.speaker: Luis Scola
quotes.summary_phrase: The talent level in the NBA is vastly superior to other leagues
quotes.excerpt: the level of talent that is in the NBA is infinitely superior to the second level, any
quotes.quote: It is true that the level of talent that is in the NBA is infinitely superior to the second level, any. The first step is a wild bull and they shoot from half court and they have zero grams of fat.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: También es verdad que el nivel de talento que hay en la NBA es tremendamente superior, pero infinitamente superior al segundo nivel, cualquiera. Y que el primer paso es un toro salvaje y que tiran de mitad de cancha y que tienen cero gramos de grasa.

quotes.speaker: Luis Scola
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's physical dominance in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: physically, LeBron James. There are many, many, but LeBron James, once you face him, you are amazed.
quotes.quote: Physically, LeBron James. There are many, many, but LeBron James, once you face him, you are amazed.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Físicamente, LeBron. Hay muchos, muchos, pero LeBron, una vez que te enfrentas, alucinas.

quotes.speaker: Luis Scola
quotes.summary_phrase: Dirk Nowitzki was a uniquely difficult player to defend
quotes.excerpt: Dirk Nowitzki was an incredible torture, impossible. In his moment, difficult, and I had good games.
quotes.quote: Dirk Nowitzki was an incredible torture, impossible. In his moment, difficult, and I had good games.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Dirk Nowitzki fue una tortura increíble, imposible. En su momento, difícil, y tuve partidos buenos.

quotes.speaker: Luis Scola
quotes.summary_phrase: Argentina's 2004 Olympic victory over the United States
quotes.excerpt: we had a very good team and we played very good basketball. If you take the ten best players
quotes.quote: We had a very good team and we played very good basketball. If you take the ten best players in the history of Argentina, they were on that team. And that talks a little bit about luck, because in general, the ten best players in the history of any team are spread out over time.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Teníamos un muy buen equipo y jugábamos muy bien al básquet. Y ese equipo tenía, si agarrás los diez mejores jugadores de la historia de Argentina, estaban en ese equipo. Y eso habla un poco de suerte, porque en general, los diez mejores jugadores de la historia de cualquier equipo van repartidos en el tiempo.

quotes.speaker: Luis Scola
quotes.summary_phrase: The cyclical nature of international team dominance
quotes.excerpt: teams make curves and they change. There are moments that the United States is invincible
quotes.quote: Teams make curves and they change. There are moments that the United States is invincible, and there are moments that Serbia is invincible, and there are moments that Lithuania is invincible, and there are moments that France is invincible.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Los equipos van haciendo curvas y van cambiando. Hay momentos que Estados Unidos es invencible, y hay momentos que Serbia es invencible, y hay momentos que Lituania es invencible, y hay momentos que Francia es invencible.

quotes.speaker: Luis Scola
quotes.summary_phrase: Scola's career highlights: Olympic medal, flag bearer, and NBA debut
quotes.excerpt: if I had to choose three, it would be the medal, the day I was flag bearer
quotes.quote: If I had to choose three, it would be the medal, the day I was flag bearer, and the debut in the NBA. If I had to choose three, those three define my career.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Si tuviera que elegir tres, sería la medalla, el día que fui abanderado, y el debut en la NBA. Si tuviera que elegir tres, esos tres definen mi carrera.

quotes.speaker: Luis Scola
quotes.summary_phrase: Scola's longevity as a top FIBA World Cup scorer
quotes.excerpt: you are the second maximum scorer in the history of the FIBA World Cups. Oscar Schmidt is closed.
quotes.quote: You are the second maximum scorer in the history of the FIBA World Cups. Oscar Schmidt is closed, so that was only about scoring points. That speaks also of a validity, of a lot of time in the elite, and that is a thing that I take with pride.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Sos el segundo máximo anotador de la historia de los mundiales FIBA. Oscar Schmidt está cerrado, o sea que era solo meter puntos. Eso habla también de una vigencia, de mucho tiempo ahí en la elite, y eso es una cosa que me lo llevo con orgullo.

quotes.speaker: Luis Scola
quotes.summary_phrase: Adapting training and nutrition for longevity in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I changed my diet, I started to train. I was improving my way of taking care of myself
quotes.quote: I changed my diet, I started to train. I was improving my way of taking care of myself with the passing of time and I took it to some extreme, let's say, unsustainable.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Cambié la alimentación, empecé a entrenar. Fui mejorando mi manera de cuidarme con el correr del tiempo y la llevé hasta algún extremo, digamos, insostenible.

quotes.speaker: Luis Scola
quotes.summary_phrase: The challenge of maintaining performance as an aging athlete
quotes.excerpt: when you are young, you do very little and you yield much. You have to do many things
quotes.quote: When you are young, you do very little and you yield much. You have to do many things to yield little, to not fall so fast.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Cuando sos joven, hacés muy poquito y rendís mucho. Tenés que hacer muchas cosas para rendir poco, para no caerte tan rápido.

quotes.speaker: Luis Scola
quotes.summary_phrase: The pressure of Olympic qualification during the World Cup
quotes.excerpt: we played the World Cup that qualified for the Olympic Games, which was the final of my career
quotes.quote: We played the World Cup that qualified for the Olympic Games, which was the final of my career, the final objective. And for that World Cup, I trained a lot, I did many things to arrive well.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Nosotros jugamos el mundial que clasificaba al juego olímpico, que era el final de mi carrera, el objetivo final. Y para ese mundial, entrené mucho, hice muchas cosas para llegar bien a ese mundial.

quotes.speaker: Luis Scola
quotes.summary_phrase: Watching Giannis Antetokounmpo made Scola realize his time was up
quotes.excerpt: I was outside the rotation and Giannis appeared. I was following him, what is this kid doing?
quotes.quote: I was outside the rotation and Giannis appeared. I was following him, what is this kid doing? He is a ten, what is he doing? I said, why are we both here? Why are we both here?
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Yo estaba en el banco, ya estaba fuera de la rotación y apareció Giannis. Yo iba siguiéndolo, ¿qué hace este pibe? Un diez, ¿qué está haciendo? Yo decía, ¿por qué estamos acá los dos? ¿Por qué estamos acá los dos?

quotes.speaker: Luis Scola
quotes.summary_phrase: Scola on the difficulty of retiring from basketball
quotes.excerpt: I feel that it was a towel to which there was no more to take out.
quotes.quote: I feel that it was a towel to which there was no more to take out.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Siento que era una toalla a la que no había más para sacarle.
